user.title: Add Hanchu ESS inverter
user.description: Select a discovered inverter to add it to Home Assistant.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Hanchu ESS inverter
reconfigure.description: Update the BLE details for this inverter.

battery_only.title: Add Hanchu batteries only
battery_only.description: No Hanchu inverter was found, but Hanchu batteries are in range. If your batteries are paired with another brand of inverter (e.g. LuxPower), choose them here to add just the batteries. There are no inverter sensors or controls in this mode.

error.address_change_not_supported: Remove and re-add the inverter to change its BLE address.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a Bluetooth address like AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

abort.not_supported: This discovered Hanchu device is not a supported inverter.
abort.no_devices_found: No Hanchu inverter or battery was found over Bluetooth. Check that it is in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then try again.
abort.battery_only_reconfigure: There is nothing to reconfigure for batteries on their own. Use Configure to choose the batteries or change the poll interval.

init.title: Batteries
init.description: Choose which Hanchu batteries to poll over Bluetooth.

data_description.battery_scan_interval: Batteries on their own only: how often each battery is read, one after another. 60 to 3600 seconds.
